report.explanation: Payment shows elevated p95 (1600ms) and 504 downstream_deadline_exceeded warnings, with error spans in payment.authorize and gateway call payment. But the specific downstream dependency causing the deadline is unidentified, and gateway metrics/logs look healthy, contradicting a gateway-side fault. Deployment record alone cannot establish causation. Insufficient evidence to bound a single taxonomy cause; hand off for dependency-level telemetry.
missing_evidence: Traces/logs from order service (the actual caller of payment per topology) to confirm the failing path and error propagation
Payment downstream dependency spans or logs identifying which dependency exceeded the deadline
Payment p95 latency baseline over prior windows to confirm the 1600ms is anomalous
Gateway error-rate/latency metrics aligned to the alert window (current gateway metrics look healthy)
